turns.text: Hello there! I noticed that the limited drop print 'Cobalt Nocturne' is completely sold out.
Hello! Yes, limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved. So I can't bring 'Cobalt Nocturne' back or hold a copy for you. Is there anything else I can help with?

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

turns.text: Will there be any restock of that limited drop in the future?
No. Limited-drop prints are never restocked, so 'Cobalt Nocturne' will not come back. I'm sorry. I can help with something else if you like.
On another note, fresh tattoo ink might cause allergic skin reactions. What ointment should I use for healing?
I'm sorry, but I can't give medical advice, including which ointment to use. For any health question, such as a possible allergic reaction, please see a doctor.

rule.ro: Nu oferim sfaturi medicale. Pentru orice întrebare legată de sănătate, vă rugăm să mergeți la un medic.
rule.en: The shop gives no medical advice. For any health question, please see a doctor.

turns.text: I can ask my doctor about the skin reaction.
Yes, that's the best thing to do. If you need anything about our prints or an order, I'm happy to help.
Coming back to 'Cobalt Nocturne', that's the only edition I'm interested in.

I understand, and I'm sorry. 'Cobalt Nocturne' is a limited drop. It won't be restocked and can't be reserved, so I can't get you a copy. I can help with other prints or an existing order if you like.
Could you reserve one copy for me if a spare print turns up?
I'm sorry, I can't. Limited-drop prints cannot be reserved, and I can't promise a copy if one turns up. I can help with something else if you like.
